chapter: Trent's band: Arkansas, Dallas and the Adolphus
title: Local substitute bands and Don Bester across the street
summary: Bands who filled in during the band's vacation fail; Troy Floyd and others spring up, and Don Bester opens at the Baker Hotel.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: ----------TIME AGO, IT WAS JUST UNUSUAL, BECAUSE REALLY YOU GUYS WERE THE ONLY ONES EVER TO DO THAT, BECAUSE NONE OF
THOSE OTHER BANDS THERE, THEY HAD A LITTLE BAND THAT TOOK YOUR PLACE WHEN YOU USED TO GO OUT ON VACATION, A LITTLE LOCAL BAND DOWN THERE.
Yeah.
WHAT'S HIS NAME.
From San Antonio. Troy Floyd.
NO NOT TROY FLOYD.
What was the name of the band.
HE DIED. THE ALTO PLAYER. THE SATISFIED FIVE, I THINK THEY CALLED THEM. FRED MURPHY AND THE SATISFIED FIVE.
Yeah, I don't think it was Murphy.
TWO BROTHERS, I THINK ONE OF THEM WAS AN ALTO PLAYER, FRED MURPHY I THINK WAS THE ONE THAT WAS THE GOOD MUSICIAN, THEY WORKED DAY JOBS, THEY WOULDN'T GO OUT OF TOWN. THEY HAD A GOOD LOCAL REPUTATION.
We went off on vacation. They gave us a vacation after we had been there for 6 months and we had this band and Troy Floyd.
I THOUGHT TROY FLOYD WAS DOWN----

He was down there. But they had this band come in there and these guys obviously weren't up to it or they didn't care, because they only had the job for two weeks and Mr. E----called after the first 5 days and said I'm sorry, but you guys aren't worth a damn.
THERE WAS NO OTHER BAND AROUND THERE TO TAKE YOUR PLACE.
After they heard us, they started springing up, Troy Floyd and another guy.
HITE BANDS IN THERE TOO, DIDN'T THEY?
Yeah, oh yeah.
WHAT WAS THAT BAND THAT YOU CLOSED OUT----TOM BEDFORD'S THAT YOU CLOSED OUT?
No, it was Bester, it was...
DON BESTER OPENED IN THE BAKER HOTEL ACROSS THE STREET.
He opened at the Baker across the street.
AND THEN YOU GUYS CLOSED HIM OUT, BECAUSE NOBODY WANTED TO HEAR HIM AFTER THEY KNEW ABOUT YOUR BAND.
Yeah. The band was sensational. When we finally finished our engagement at the A------. The Baker wanted to hire us to come over there.
